endpoint: Within-plate end-to-end yield repeatability of a single repeated reaction per class, 96 wells each; not low-yield analytical precision.
concentration_and_reaction_volume: Not specified for these three validation plates.
batch_information: One full 96-well plate per reaction class. Plate identifiers, dates and independent day/batch replicate counts are not supplied with these benchmark data.
analytical_method_scope: The platform workflow is DESI-TOF-MS triage, selected UPLC-UV/MS and selected 1H NMR calibration. Individual well-level measurement tiers are not specified.
statistics_convention: Recalculated from 96 recorded integer-percentage yields per reaction class. Sample CV = stdev(ddof=1)/mean*100; population CV also supplied. Original unrounded measurements are not included.

benchmarks.reaction_conditions: 4-aminoacetophenone (0.025 mmol) + 2-(4-methylphenyl)acetic acid (1.2 eq); HATU (1.5 eq), DIPEA (3.0 eq), DMF, 30 C, 3 h
3-bromo-2-methylpyridine (0.025 mmol) + 4-methoxyphenylboronic acid (1.5 eq); XPhos Pd G3 (5 mol%), K3PO4 (3 eq), 1,4-dioxane/H2O (4:1), 100 C, 12 h
1-bromo-3,5-dimethoxybenzene (0.025 mmol) + 4-methoxyaniline (1.2 eq); Pd2(dba)3 (10 mol%), XantPhos (20 mol%), K3PO4 (3 eq), 1,4-dioxane, 100 C, 16 h
